fusions.name: Fanned Hand
fusions.desc: Throws 3 knives in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Closing Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a knife that deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Studied Anatomy
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Ten Thousand Cuts
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
